text:
aisha_sales: Quick sync — Acme wants a Dedicated endpoint in eu-west-1 with a single static outbound IP for allowlisting. Demo scheduled next Wed; can we confirm egress options + any pricing add-on? @jamie_netops
jamie_netops: Two patterns: 1) Redwood-owned static EIPs attached to the Dedicated pool (recommended), or 2) customer-managed NAT/proxy. We can reserve EIPs in eu-west-1. Do they need IP rotation?
acme_it: One IP is preferred. Rotation OK if scheduled. Only need outbound 443.
ravi_eng: We can provide active/standby EIPs and weekly rotation if requested, but rotation will require notify windows for strict allowlists. We also support mTLS client certs on the Dedicated endpoint for extra assurance.
elena_security: Their security questionnaire asks for TLS1.3, AES-GCM, HSM-backed KMS for key material, and audit log delivery. They want logs delivered to their S3 bucket. Also requested SOC2 report.
aisha_sales: I'll send SOC2. @ravi_eng can we support cross-account delivery of audit logs to customer S3?
ravi_eng: Yes — cross-account S3 delivery via an IAM role. Need bucket ARN and write policy. I'll draft the trust role and the config steps.
jamie_netops: For firewall rules give them the EIP(s) and allow outbound to those IPs on 443. If they insist on DNS/SNI allowlisting we'd need to share FQDNs but for strict allowlist we give EIP(s).
aisha_sales: Offer short-lived Hosted API keys for smoke tests (72h TTL) while networking is set up, then swap to Dedicated keys.
acme_it: Cost estimate for Dedicated + static EIP + 99% SLO for POC?
ravi_eng: Ballpark: reserved Dedicated commit + small static-egress add-on. I'll annotate the quote with expected GPU/vCPU hours; sales to finalize numbers.
acme_it: Can we get redundancy if an EIP fails?
jamie_netops: We'll provision 2 EIPs (active/standby) and failover at the NAT level.
deploy-bot: Reserved 2 EIPs in eu-west-1 for project-acme-poc (res id: rp-ACME-42).
aisha_sales: Action items:
- Acme: send single /32 list + S3 ARN by EOD Tue
- Jamie: confirm exact EIP values & NAT failover plan
- Ravi: cross-account role template and step-by-step config
- Me: provisional quote + temp Hosted keys :thumbsup:
acme_it: Thanks — sending details now.
